title: Migrate a JSON action while preserving a multipart upload
setup: A disposable Moodle checkout contains an installed activity plugin with a teacher-only JSON settings action in ajax.php, a dedicated multipart upload endpoint reading $_FILES, and distinct JavaScript callers. Generated teacher and student accounts can access the course.
prompt: Move the legacy settings action to Moodle's supported AJAX flow. Preserve the separate file upload and the existing permissions.
checks: The settings action is registered with ajax enabled and exposes an explicit parameter and return contract.
The settings caller uses core/ajax with the registered methodname and schema-matching args. The plugin upgrade registers the function.
A teacher can save valid settings. Invalid input and users without the required activity capability cannot change settings.
The multipart upload still submits FormData and succeeds for an authorized user. It has not been moved to the JSON transport.
